author: Galrandir
body:
• username: Galrandir
  • The reason you were temp-banned/banned: Void Logging
  • Why you should be unbanned from the server: I am honestly sorry for void logging, I just get really annoyed when someone steals your monument which you have worked hard to get, and then get shot off by another player. I understand that I do deserve this tempban, but I do apologise. If I may do this again, I will agree to a full tempban or ban in the future. With the first tourney match coming up, my team also needs me and I must attend this match. Again, I apologise for void logging. But I do get angry from time to time, although I think I have learnt my lesson NOT to void log and I would like a final chance to prove that I will not void log again.

Thankyou,
Galrandir

title: My tempban appeal

replies.author: DJ_Barnsey
replies.body:
Hello,

I have decided to appeal this infraction due to it being a little harsh. 

This offence should be max 1 day Temp-ban max, maybe more if it was a repeated offence. In this case this was your first offence.

Regards,
LegendaryEngram, Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
